title: STARTEX — 21:30 CST Under the PDS Tornado Watch

fields.location: Brennan County EOC and Warning Operations Floor, Ashford, Kentucky
fields.weather: 71°F, dewpoint 66°F, S wind 20 mph gusting 35 mph, light rain showers
fields.load: Routine 911 call volume; no warning in effect for Brennan County
fields.staffing: EOC at Level 2: EM Director, on-duty Warning Officer, PIO; 911 floor: two telecommunicators and one supervisor
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 21:30 CST on Friday, December 11, 2026, and Ashford is unusually warm and humid for December. The Storm Prediction Center's 15:00 Day 1 outlook puts Brennan County in a Moderate (4) risk with significant tornadoes possible after dark, and NWS Paducah's afternoon briefing warned of a fast-moving line with embedded tornadoes between 22:00 and 02:00. At 20:15 SPC issued a Particularly Dangerous Situation tornado watch for the county, valid until 04:00. The BCEMA EOC is at Level 2 with EM Director Dana Whitfield, the on-duty Warning Officer and PIO Caleb Harmon in the room, Channel 6 StormTeam Chief Meteorologist Marisa Kent is doing cut-ins between programs, and no warning is in effect for Brennan County.

status.name: Outdoor warning sirens (46, four zones)
status.note: 44 of 46 pass polling. North zone N-07 (Pine Hollow) and N-11 (Clarks River bridge) out of service since the November test, awaiting parts. Encoder at 911 Position 2; EOC backup available.

status.name: BrennanAlert
status.note: About 14,200 subscribers; text, voice and email available. Voice delivery takes up to 12 minutes countywide.

status.name: IPAWS (county WEA and EAS)
status.note: English and Spanish templates loaded; no county messages sent tonight.

status.name: NOAA Weather Radio / NWS feeds
status.note: Paducah transmitter on air; NWSChat and the NOAA Weather Wire receiver online.

status.name: SKYWARN spotter net (147.315 MHz)
status.note: County VHF repeater up; Spotter Coordinator Lena Brooks running the net.

status.name: Community safe rooms
status.note: Ashford Middle School and Corwin Community Center not open. Capacity 300 each.

status.name: Power, cell service and 911 floor
status.note: No outages reported. 911 call volume routine.

fields.facilitatorNote: Read the card, then have each role confirm its position, comms (NWSChat, NOAA Weather Wire, SKYWARN net on 147.315 MHz, the Channel 6 contact line) and the watch timeline, and open the warning log. Do not prompt on the safe rooms: the night PDS watch with a Moderate risk already meets the plan's opening trigger. Note whether the EM Director spots that.
fields.scenarioTitle: Rain-Wrapped — Night Tornado Warning & Shelter Timing

instructorNote: This card sets the baseline. Watch whether roles confirm their comms and open the warning log. Also watch whether anyone notices that a nighttime tornado watch with a Moderate outlook already calls for opening both safe rooms under EOP 3.3, and that two North zone sirens are out of service.
